- If you prefer we can provision a shorter 20-minute high-level product brief in the meantime (no deep dive), but we wont share infra-level diagrams until intake is complete.

- Mon Aug 24, 10:00–10:45
- Tue Aug 25, 09:30–10:15
- Wed Aug 26, 13:00–13:45

Hi team — I reviewed AuroraMeds intake form. High-level notes:
- Their questionnaire maps closely to our standard controls; I estimate a 48–72 hour review once they return the completed form.
- NDA: we can sign their standard mutual NDA after a brief legal check (usually < 2 business days).
- Data flow diagram: we will provide a redacted/high-level diagram for the briefing; detailed diagrams with PII paths require the intake to be fully approved.

Next steps I recommend we send to AuroraMed today:
1) Redwood onboarding checklist (attached)
2) A DocuSign link for our countersign or to accept their NDA template
3) A short intake contact list so procurement knows who to loop in for questions

Ill prepare a short review template to speed procurement signoff. Rafael, if you want I can also include a short note about the limited-scope 20-minute preview call in case they want to do that first.

Mina Haddad
